use_case: Dam-safety sensor anomaly detection: a third-party AI SaaS that flags unusual patterns in Client B piezometer and seepage weir readings for the gate reliability and instrumentation review study
vendor_or_model: Small AI anomaly detection SaaS vendor (machine learning model fitted to the uploaded history); free trial under click-through terms
data_categories: Client B instrument readings (28 piezometers and 3 seepage weirs, three years; Client confidential); no CEII, no security-sensitive material, no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. The owner plots and reviews every instrument by hand; flags are leads, never findings; every conclusion is the owner's own and sealed (18 CFR 12.36(g) and (h))
applicable_laws: GRS-B (1) and (3) (no third-party sharing without written consent; 24-hour incident notice); 18 CFR 12.36(b)(1), (g), (h); 18 CFR 12.10(a)(1) (licensee's duty, indirectly); 18 CFR 388.113(h)(2) and CSCA-A (1) (prohibited inputs); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Retired (uploaded 2026-05-19; stopped 2026-07-20; vendor deletion confirmed 2026-08-12; rejected 2026-08-31; any reuse needs a new P10 assessment and Client B's written consent)
